In src/app.module.ts, ApplicationModule pulls in the feature modules (ArticleModule, UserModule, ProfileModule, TagModule), sets up TypeOrmModule.forRoot() and registers AppController. In src/app.controller.ts, AppController has a single root() handler that returns a constant string. No rule or invariant is repeated, and nothing goes around the module's own abstractions: the feature modules are only pulled in through Nest module imports, not reached into. One small smell: ApplicationModule injects `Connection` and never uses it. That is dead code, not a cohesion or duplication problem, so the unit passes.
